name: SubsyncStarter
description: Automatically re-syncs out-of-sync subtitles using ffsubsync.
overview: Scans configured library paths for subtitles, matches each one to its video, and calls the subsync-sidecar service (ffsubsync) to fix any timing drift. Defaults as a scheduled sweep (daily + on server startup) with a skip-cache so repeat runs are cheap, and doubles as a manual 'Run Now' trigger from Dashboard > Scheduled Tasks.

versions.changelog: Initial release. Scheduled library sweep, skip-cache, and admin config page wired up against the subsync-sidecar HTTP service.
